3482625420.detail_text: Aromatic incense has been used for centuries to enhance spiritual practices, create ambiance, and promote well-being. Each type of incense carries unique benefits based on its scent profile and properties. Here's an overview of the benefits of these selected assorted aromatic incense: Patchouli - Deep, earthy, and musky, patchouli incense helps ground the mind, ease stress, and enhance relaxation. It's often used for meditation and spiritual cleansing. Sandalwood - A warm, woody aroma known for its calming effects, sandalwood incense promotes mental clarity, reduces anxiety, and fosters a peaceful atmosphere. White Sage - Traditionally used for purification, white sage clears negative energy, enhances focus, and promotes healing. It's widely used in smudging rituals. Oud (Agarwood) - Rich, resinous, and intoxicating, oud is prized for its luxurious and soothing scent. It aids in deep meditation, spiritual awakening, and emotional balance. Rose - A delicate floral fragrance that inspires love, harmony, and emotional healing. Rose incense is often used for enhancing mood and fostering self-love. Lime - A bright and citrusy scent, lime incense is energizing and refreshing, helping to uplift the mood and improve focus. Bakhoor - A traditional Middle Eastern incense made from wood chips soaked in fragrant oils, bakhoor brings warmth, depth, and a sense of comfort, making spaces feel luxurious and inviting. Vetiver - Deeply grounding and earthy, vetiver incense promotes relaxation, stabilizes emotions, and supports mental clarity. It’s often used to combat anxiety and stress. Deer Musk - With its rich, musky aroma, deer musk incense enhances sensuality, deepens meditation, and fosters an aura of mystique and sophistication. Javadhu - A traditional Indian incense with a sweet, floral, and slightly woody aroma. Javadhu is known for its ability to uplift the spirit, enhance meditation, and create a serene atmosphere. Galbanum - With its fresh, green, and slightly woody scent, galbanum incense is invigorating and grounding. It is often used to promote emotional balance, clarity, and a sense of renewal. Each of these scents plays a role in transforming the ambiance of a space, whether it's for relaxation, spiritual practice, or simply indulging in aromatic luxury. The combination of aromatic incense aromas has a profound impact on our senses, emotions, and overall well-being. Box contains 15 packets. Each packet contains 50 grams net contents. Approximately 12 sticks per packet, total sticks per box 144 sticks. Except Sandal & Blue Heaven its 40 grams net content, approximately 10 stick per packet, total sticks 120 sticks.

  • Rose - A delicate floral fragrance that inspires love, harmony, and emotional healing. Rose incense is often used for enhancing mood and fostering self-love.
  • Lime - A bright and citrusy scent, lime incense is energizing and refreshing, helping to uplift the mood and improve focus.
  • Bakhoor - A traditional Middle Eastern incense made from wood chips soaked in fragrant oils, bakhoor brings warmth, depth, and a sense of comfort, making spaces feel luxurious and inviting.
  • Vetiver - Deeply grounding and earthy, vetiver incense promotes relaxation, stabilizes emotions, and supports mental clarity. It’s often used to combat anxiety and stress.
  • Deer Musk - With its rich, musky aroma, deer musk incense enhances sensuality, deepens meditation, and fosters an aura of mystique and sophistication.
  • Javadhu - A traditional Indian incense with a sweet, floral, and slightly woody aroma. Javadhu is known for its ability to uplift the spirit, enhance meditation, and create a serene atmosphere.
  •  Galbanum - With its fresh, green, and slightly woody scent, galbanum incense is invigorating and grounding. It is often used to promote emotional balance, clarity, and a sense of renewal.

Each of these scents plays a role in transforming the ambiance of a space, whether it's for relaxation, spiritual practice, or simply indulging in aromatic luxury. The combination of aromatic incense aromas has a profound impact on our senses, emotions, and overall well-being.

Diptyque Car Aromatherapy Solid Perfume

Premium Black Ribbon – French Luxury for Your Car’s Atmosphere

Elevate every drive with the Diptyque Car Aromatherapy Solid Perfume—a masterpiece of French fragrance craftsmanship, designed to infuse your car with long-lasting, elegant scent while adding a touch of luxury to your dashboard. Unlike generic car air fresheners that fade fast or smell synthetic, this premium solid perfume features Diptyque’s iconic scent blend, encased in a sleek metal housing and finished with a sophisticated black ribbon for easy vent hanging. 100% authentic, imported directly from France, plus Lazada 2-day fast shipping—it’s the must-have for discerning drivers who turn daily commutes into sensory luxury moments.

French Luxury in Every Detail: Scent & Style Combined

Diptyque doesn’t just freshen your car—it transforms it into a mobile sanctuary, merging decades of fragrance expertise with timeless design:

Key Luxury Features & Scent Experience

  • Iconic Diptyque Scent Blend (Baies/Berries):

A signature fragrance loved worldwide—ripe blackcurrant buds meet crisp rose, balanced with a hint of green leaves for a fresh, fruity-floral aroma that’s never overpowering. Unlike sweet, cloying generic scents, this blend feels natural, sophisticated, and suitable for all genders (perfect for shared cars or family drives).

  • Long-Lasting Solid Formula:

Concentrated solid perfume matrix releases scent slowly and evenly—lasts 2–3 months with daily use (3x longer than liquid spray air fresheners). No messy leaks, no sudden bursts of fragrance—just a consistent, subtle aroma that greets you every time you open the car door.

  • Premium Black Ribbon & Metal Housing:
  • Sleek Metal Case: Matte black metal housing with Diptyque’s classic logo—resists scratches and heat (safe for car vents even in Southeast Asia’s hot weather).
  • Elegant Black Ribbon: Soft, durable satin ribbon for easy hanging on air vents—adds a chic, minimalist decor touch to your car interior (looks stunning with leather or fabric dashboards).
  • Safe & Non-Irritating:

Free of alcohol, harsh chemicals, and synthetic propellants—won’t trigger allergies or headaches (ideal for drivers with sensitive noses or long commutes). The solid format also avoids staining car seats or dashboards, unlike liquid fresheners.

“I’ve tried dozens of car fresheners—this Diptyque one is in a league of its own! The berry scent is fresh, not sweet, and lasts for months. The black ribbon looks so elegant on my Mercedes vent.” – @DiptyqueLuxurySG

“My partner and I both love this—no more arguing over ‘too floral’ or ‘too musky’ scents! It’s subtle enough for morning drives and makes long trips feel more relaxing.” – @CarScentLoverMY

Perfect for Every Drive: Scenario-Sized Luxury

Designed with Diptyque’s commitment to quality and Lazada drivers’ lifestyles in mind:

  • Single Unit, Long-Lasting Value:

One solid perfume lasts 2–3 months (vs. 2–3 weeks for cheap fresheners)—no frequent repurchases, making it cost-effective for luxury.

  • Compact & Non-Intrusive:

Measures just 7cm x 4cm—hangs neatly on air vents without blocking airflow or obstructing your view (safe for all car models, from sedans to SUVs).

  • Gift-Ready Elegance:

Comes in Diptyque’s iconic black-and-white packaging—ideal for gifting to car enthusiasts, luxury lovers, or anyone who appreciates small daily luxuries. Perfect for birthdays, holidays, or as a “thank you” gift.

Why This Diptyque Freshener Beats Generic Car Scents

Ordinary car air fresheners can’t match Diptyque’s luxury, scent quality, or durability—here’s how it stands out:

  • Scent Authenticity:

Generics use synthetic fragrance oils that fade fast or smell “chemical”—Diptyque’s blend is crafted by master perfumers in France, using high-quality natural extracts (blackcurrant bud, rose absolute) for a true, layered aroma.

  • Design & Durability:

Cheap fresheners are made of plastic that cracks or melts—Diptyque’s metal housing and satin ribbon are built to last, even in hot cars (tested to withstand temperatures up to 60°C, common in Malaysia/Singapore).

  • Safety & Quality:

Fake “luxury” fresheners may contain toxic chemicals—Diptyque’s formula is dermatologist-tested and compliant with global safety standards, so you can breathe easy on every drive.

  • Authenticity Guarantee:

Each unit features a unique Diptyque serial number (verifiable via Diptyque official site) and embossed logo—avoids counterfeits that smell off or break quickly.

“I bought a fake Diptyque car freshener once—it smelled like plastic and broke in 2 weeks! This authentic one is worth every cent—scent lasts, looks elegant, and makes my car feel premium.” – @AuthenticDiptyqueTH

How to Use: French Luxury in 1 Simple Step

  1. Unbox & Hang:

Remove the solid perfume from its Diptyque packaging, untie the black ribbon, and loop it around your car’s air vent (choose a vent that’s not directly facing you for subtle scent diffusion).

  1. Adjust for Scent Intensity:

For lighter scent: Hang on a vent used less frequently (e.g., passenger side). For stronger aroma: Hang on a main vent and turn on low airflow (the moving air will gently release more scent).

  1. Replace When Needed:

When the scent fades (after 2–3 months), simply remove the old unit and replace with a new Diptyque car perfume—no residue left on vents.

“Pro Tip: Pair with Diptyque’s hand cream for a cohesive scent experience—smell the same luxury in your car and on your hands! I also hang one in my home office vent for a subtle fragrance boost.” – @ScentHackSG

Ready to turn every drive into a luxury ritual? The Diptyque Car Aromatherapy Solid Perfume (Premium Black Ribbon) is in stock now on Lazada—ships fast to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and beyond. Whether you’re commuting to work, road-tripping with friends, or just running errands, this authentic French fragrance adds a touch of elegance to every mile.

Featuring the iconic Baies scent blend of blackcurrant buds and rose, it provides a fresh, subtle aroma suitable for all genders.
Its long-lasting solid formula releases scent evenly for 2–3 months without leaks or overpowering bursts.
Encased in a durable matte black metal housing with a chic black satin ribbon, it hangs easily on any car vent and endures high temperatures.
Free from alcohol and harsh chemicals, it’s safe for sensitive noses and avoids staining dashboards.
Compact and elegant, it fits all car models and adds a touch of luxury to daily drives or gifting occasions.

product.desc:
Diptyque Car Aromatherapy Solid Perfume

Premium Black Ribbon – French Luxury for Your Car’s Atmosphere

Elevate every drive with the Diptyque Car Aromatherapy Solid Perfume—a masterpiece of French fragrance craftsmanship, designed to infuse your car with long-lasting, elegant scent while adding a touch of luxury to your dashboard. Unlike generic car air fresheners that fade fast or smell synthetic, this premium solid perfume features Diptyque’s iconic scent blend, encased in a sleek metal housing and finished with a sophisticated black ribbon for easy vent hanging. 100% authentic, imported directly from France, plus Lazada 2-day fast shipping—it’s the must-have for discerning drivers who turn daily commutes into sensory luxury moments.

French Luxury in Every Detail: Scent & Style Combined

Diptyque doesn’t just freshen your car—it transforms it into a mobile sanctuary, merging decades of fragrance expertise with timeless design:

Key Luxury Features & Scent Experience

  • Iconic Diptyque Scent Blend (Baies/Berries):

A signature fragrance loved worldwide—ripe blackcurrant buds meet crisp rose, balanced with a hint of green leaves for a fresh, fruity-floral aroma that’s never overpowering. Unlike sweet, cloying generic scents, this blend feels natural, sophisticated, and suitable for all genders (perfect for shared cars or family drives).

  • Long-Lasting Solid Formula:

Concentrated solid perfume matrix releases scent slowly and evenly—lasts 2–3 months with daily use (3x longer than liquid spray air fresheners). No messy leaks, no sudden bursts of fragrance—just a consistent, subtle aroma that greets you every time you open the car door.

  • Premium Black Ribbon & Metal Housing:
  • Sleek Metal Case: Matte black metal housing with Diptyque’s classic logo—resists scratches and heat (safe for car vents even in Southeast Asia’s hot weather).
  • Elegant Black Ribbon: Soft, durable satin ribbon for easy hanging on air vents—adds a chic, minimalist decor touch to your car interior (looks stunning with leather or fabric dashboards).
  • Safe & Non-Irritating:

Free of alcohol, harsh chemicals, and synthetic propellants—won’t trigger allergies or headaches (ideal for drivers with sensitive noses or long commutes). The solid format also avoids staining car seats or dashboards, unlike liquid fresheners.

“I’ve tried dozens of car fresheners—this Diptyque one is in a league of its own! The berry scent is fresh, not sweet, and lasts for months. The black ribbon looks so elegant on my Mercedes vent.” – @DiptyqueLuxurySG

“My partner and I both love this—no more arguing over ‘too floral’ or ‘too musky’ scents! It’s subtle enough for morning drives and makes long trips feel more relaxing.” – @CarScentLoverMY

Perfect for Every Drive: Scenario-Sized Luxury

Designed with Diptyque’s commitment to quality and Lazada drivers’ lifestyles in mind:

  • Single Unit, Long-Lasting Value:

One solid perfume lasts 2–3 months (vs. 2–3 weeks for cheap fresheners)—no frequent repurchases, making it cost-effective for luxury.

  • Compact & Non-Intrusive:

Measures just 7cm x 4cm—hangs neatly on air vents without blocking airflow or obstructing your view (safe for all car models, from sedans to SUVs).

  • Gift-Ready Elegance:

Comes in Diptyque’s iconic black-and-white packaging—ideal for gifting to car enthusiasts, luxury lovers, or anyone who appreciates small daily luxuries. Perfect for birthdays, holidays, or as a “thank you” gift.

Why This Diptyque Freshener Beats Generic Car Scents

Ordinary car air fresheners can’t match Diptyque’s luxury, scent quality, or durability—here’s how it stands out:

  • Scent Authenticity:

Generics use synthetic fragrance oils that fade fast or smell “chemical”—Diptyque’s blend is crafted by master perfumers in France, using high-quality natural extracts (blackcurrant bud, rose absolute) for a true, layered aroma.

  • Design & Durability:

Cheap fresheners are made of plastic that cracks or melts—Diptyque’s metal housing and satin ribbon are built to last, even in hot cars (tested to withstand temperatures up to 60°C, common in Malaysia/Singapore).

  • Safety & Quality:

Fake “luxury” fresheners may contain toxic chemicals—Diptyque’s formula is dermatologist-tested and compliant with global safety standards, so you can breathe easy on every drive.

  • Authenticity Guarantee:

Each unit features a unique Diptyque serial number (verifiable via Diptyque official site) and embossed logo—avoids counterfeits that smell off or break quickly.

“I bought a fake Diptyque car freshener once—it smelled like plastic and broke in 2 weeks! This authentic one is worth every cent—scent lasts, looks elegant, and makes my car feel premium.” – @AuthenticDiptyqueTH

How to Use: French Luxury in 1 Simple Step

  1. Unbox & Hang:

Remove the solid perfume from its Diptyque packaging, untie the black ribbon, and loop it around your car’s air vent (choose a vent that’s not directly facing you for subtle scent diffusion).

  1. Adjust for Scent Intensity:

For lighter scent: Hang on a vent used less frequently (e.g., passenger side). For stronger aroma: Hang on a main vent and turn on low airflow (the moving air will gently release more scent).

  1. Replace When Needed:

When the scent fades (after 2–3 months), simply remove the old unit and replace with a new Diptyque car perfume—no residue left on vents.

“Pro Tip: Pair with Diptyque’s hand cream for a cohesive scent experience—smell the same luxury in your car and on your hands! I also hang one in my home office vent for a subtle fragrance boost.” – @ScentHackSG

Ready to turn every drive into a luxury ritual? The Diptyque Car Aromatherapy Solid Perfume (Premium Black Ribbon) is in stock now on Lazada—ships fast to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and beyond. Whether you’re commuting to work, road-tripping with friends, or just running errands, this authentic French fragrance adds a touch of elegance to every mile.

  • Top notes: Orange, Lemon, Bergamot

  • Heart notes: Rose, Peony, Gardenia

  • Top notes: Lemon, Orange, Neroli
  • Heart notes: Rose, Jasmine, Violet Leaves

  • Top notes: Neroli, Raspberry Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Jasmine, Pear, Patchouli, Vanilla flower

  • Heart notes: Red Fruits, Rose, Cinnamon

Intensity of the fragrance #1 Humidity and room temperature Why? Is it safe for pregnant ladies, children and elderlies? #2 How often to change the reeds? #3 What will be included in the set? #4 How long can 50ml, 100ml and 200ml last? #2 Good air circulation but not too much Place your reed diffuser in a room with sufficient humidity and moderate temperature. Suppose your room temperature is relatively low and the air is dry. In that case, it will create slow-moving scent molecules, which cannot travel very far and at the same time, dry air will increase the speed of oil evaporation. This also means that even though your diffuser is diffusing more, the scent molecules cannot travel far enough to cover your room with the fragrance, especially if it is a large space. Place your reed diffuser in constant foot traffic that moves the molecules in the air naturally to carry the scent around and not directly under the fan or aircon; anywhere with direct wind blowing at it. Any fast-moving and robust air can cause oil evaporation to happen more quickly and unnecessarily. Fibre reeds are designed specifically for the purpose of oil wicking and scent dispersal. Its porosity distribution is uniform, ensuring optimal oil distribution throughout the reed. These reeds soak up and diffuse scent stronger. DO NOT use bamboo or rattan reeds! Bamboo nodes stop oil from spreading and rattan reeds is not as efficient as fibre in absorption. Oils with too many synthetic fillers can clog the reeds, causing them to stop diffusing the scent. Poorly mixed oils may allow for a heavy smell at first and evaporate too fast that it consumes oils too quickly. Simply put them on a tray! Remember to close the bottle's cap and cover the reeds with some cloth to prevent dust, hair, or dirt particles from the room. If the scent is not as strong as it was, flip the reeds for fresh fragrance burst. You can also do it once in 2-3 weeks. Increase the number of reeds in the diffuser for a more intense scent. ** However to note that more reeds also means faster evaporation! Just use what you need :) Reeds may get clogged up with dust over time. You may replace the reeds when flipping reeds does not work anymore, if not once every 2 months. You may also purchase reeds from us if reeds are ineffective after 2 months. Our ingredients are made of essential oils and organic water-soluble. It is safe for general use as home fragrance to scent your home. Just be careful of spilling and do not put near flame. Reed Diffuser oils shouldn't touch your skin, not for consuming or ingesting in any way. About every 6 months. Reed diffuser bottle, a set of 6 reed sticks, stopper, QR code for special gift 50ml can last 2-3 weeks, 100ml can last 4-6 weeks and 200ml can last 8-10 weeks. However, it depends the number of reeds used and the environment the reed diffusers are placed in as mentioned above. This captivating fragrance combines the sophistication of the iconic Supremacy collection with a fresh, invigorating blend of white florals and warm amber. Ideal for special occasions, Supremacy Collector's Edition leaves a lasting impression of elegance and strength. Perfume Notes Top Notes: Pineapple, bergamot, apple, white floral Middle Notes: Orange blossom, birch, amber Base Notes: Oak moss, musk, ambergris The fragrance opens with a vibrant mix of pineapple, bergamot, and apple, balanced by soft white florals, creating an inviting, fresh start. It transitions into a heart of rich amber and birch, complemented by the subtle sweetness of orange blossom. The base is deep and earthy, with oak moss, musk, and ambergris adding an enduring touch of warmth and sophistication. Why Choose Afnan Supremacy Collector's Edition? This fragrance is crafted for those who value legacy and presence, blending classic allure with a refreshing contemporary vibe. With its unique combination of fruity freshness and ambery warmth, Supremacy Collector's Edition is a versatile yet distinguished scent, perfect for making a statement at any special occasion.

Pack Type：Single Item Scent：Pineapple,Apple,Floral Fragrance Concentration：Eau De Parfum Feature：Natural Item Name：Afnan Supremacy Collector's edition Volume：3 To 3.9 Fl Oz Ingredient Feature：Long Lasting Quantity Per Pack：1 Age Group：Adults (Inactive) Ingredients：Linolool,Limonene,Aqua,Parfum,Denat Shelf Life：24 Months Manufacturer：Afnan Contains Or Aerosol：Contains Edition：Limited Edition Product Form：Liquid Afnan Supremacy Collector's Edition Eau de Parfum for Men 3.4 Oz  Afnan’s Supremacy Collector's Edition 3.4 fl oz celebrates the essence of refined masculinity, crafted for those who appreciate timeless elegance with a modern twist. This captivating fragrance combines the sophistication of the iconic Supremacy collection with a fresh, invigorating blend of white florals and warm amber. Ideal for special occasions, Supremacy Collector's Edition leaves a lasting impression of elegance and strength.Perfume NotesTop Notes: Pineapple, bergamot, apple, white floralMiddle Notes: Orange blossom, birch, amberBase Notes: Oak moss, musk, ambergris The fragrance opens with a vibrant mix of pineapple, bergamot, and apple, balanced by soft white florals, creating an inviting, fresh start. It transitions into a heart of rich amber and birch, complemented by the subtle sweetness of orange blossom. The base is deep and earthy, with oak moss, musk, and ambergris adding an enduring touch of warmth and sophistication.  Why Choose Afnan Supremacy Collector's Edition?This fragrance is crafted for those who value legacy and presence, blending classic allure with a refreshing contemporary vibe. With its unique combination of fruity freshness and ambery warmth, Supremacy Collector's Edition is a versatile yet distinguished scent, perfect for making a statement at any special occasion.

3315238464.detail_text: Did I love a dream? The faun, a creature of sylvan life, awakens from his mid-day sleep and contemplates his morning’s pursuit of alluring nymphs. In his reflections, the chase takes on libidinous proportions as he seeks to satisfy his desire. It is a beautiful memory — but did it really happen? Images fade. Those delicious sensations that tease his mind grow vague, and he cannot recapture the events. Reality eludes him, confusion reigns, until he is no longer certain if he is remembering fact or fancy. Once again, he is overcome by sleep, which can only lead to more dreaming. Top notes: Bergamot, Cinnamon, Incense Heart notes: Rose, Iris, Jasmin Base notes: Myrrh, Leather, Benzoin

3037987036.detail_text: Stylishly presented in a bottle reminiscent of an old apothecary flask, Touch for Men combines tradition, history and modernity. The elegant masculinity of a woody musk expresses well-being and authenticity. Invigorating white pepper and the smoothness of Virginia wood and oak moss. Like a strong, deep breath, the trail develops quietly into a sturdy, masculine alchemy of vetiver, white musk and tonka bean. Notes: - Top: artemisia, mandarin tree, violet leaves. - Middle: nutmeg, Virginia cedarwood, white pepper. - Base: vetiver, soft white musk, tonka bean.
3037987036.detail_html:
Stylishly presented in a bottle reminiscent of an old apothecary flask, Touch for Men combines tradition, history and modernity. The elegant masculinity of a woody musk expresses well-being and authenticity. Invigorating white pepper and the smoothness of Virginia wood and oak moss. Like a strong, deep breath, the trail develops quietly into a sturdy, masculine alchemy of vetiver, white musk and tonka bean.

Notes:

- Top: artemisia, mandarin tree, violet leaves.

product.desc:
Introducing our company's flagship product: the 500ml Large Capacity Aroma Essential Oil Refill. Designed to cater to all types of nebulizers, atomizers, ultrasonic diffusers, and humidifiers, our essential oil refill brings a delightful sensory experience to your space.

We offer an impressive selection of inspired waterless perfume fragrances and essential oils for various settings and moods. From the sophisticated inspired ambiance of Singapore attractions, a luxury hotel, the captivating allure of floral notes, and the familiarity of famous perfumes, our range caters to diverse preferences. Each fragrance is carefully crafted to create a unique and immersive atmosphere, enhancing the overall ambiance of any room.

Our 500ml capacity ensures long-lasting usage, allowing you to enjoy your favorite fragrance for extended periods without frequent refills. The generous size also offers excellent value for money, providing ample supply to indulge in the scents you love.

Whether you seek relaxation, rejuvenation, or wish to create an inviting environment, our Aroma Essential Oil Refill is the perfect solution. Immerse yourself in a world of captivating fragrances that uplift your mood, soothe your senses, and transform your space into a sanctuary.

Experience the power of scent with our 500ml large-capacity aroma Essential Oil Refill. Elevate your surroundings and indulge in the luxurious fragrances that bring harmony, tranquility, and a touch of elegance to your everyday life.

💢If you have any doubts regarding whether your machine can use our 500ml perfume fragrance essential oil, kindly contact us, and we will give you valuable suggestions.

Intensity of the fragrance #1 Humidity and room temperature Why? Is it safe for pregnant ladies, children and elderlies? #2 How often to change the reeds? #3 What will be included in the set? #4 How long can 50ml, 100ml and 200ml last? #2 Good air circulation but not too much Place your reed diffuser in a room with sufficient humidity and moderate temperature. Suppose your room temperature is relatively low and the air is dry. In that case, it will create slow-moving scent molecules, which cannot travel very far and at the same time, dry air will increase the speed of oil evaporation. This also means that even though your diffuser is diffusing more, the scent molecules cannot travel far enough to cover your room with the fragrance, especially if it is a large space. Place your reed diffuser in constant foot traffic that moves the molecules in the air naturally to carry the scent around and not directly under the fan or aircon; anywhere with direct wind blowing at it. Any fast-moving and robust air can cause oil evaporation to happen more quickly and unnecessarily. Fibre reeds are designed specifically for the purpose of oil wicking and scent dispersal. Its porosity distribution is uniform, ensuring optimal oil distribution throughout the reed. These reeds soak up and diffuse scent stronger. DO NOT use bamboo or rattan reeds! Bamboo nodes stop oil from spreading and rattan reeds is not as efficient as fibre in absorption. Oils with too many synthetic fillers can clog the reeds, causing them to stop diffusing the scent. Poorly mixed oils may allow for a heavy smell at first and evaporate too fast that it consumes oils too quickly. Simply put them on a tray! Remember to close the bottle's cap and cover the reeds with some cloth to prevent dust, hair, or dirt particles from the room. If the scent is not as strong as it was, flip the reeds for fresh fragrance burst. You can also do it once in 2-3 weeks. Increase the number of reeds in the diffuser for a more intense scent. ** However to note that more reeds also means faster evaporation! Just use what you need :) Reeds may get clogged up with dust over time. You may replace the reeds when flipping reeds does not work anymore, if not once every 2 months. You may also purchase reeds from us if reeds are ineffective after 2 months. Our ingredients are made of essential oils and organic water-soluble. It is safe for general use as home fragrance to scent your home. Just be careful of spilling and do not put near flame. Reed Diffuser oils shouldn't touch your skin, not for consuming or ingesting in any way. About every 6 months. However, it depends the number of reeds used and the environment the reed diffusers are placed in as mentioned above. Top notes of bergamot, litchi and blackcurrant open the scent with a fresh, sweet essence that makes you feel like a true lady. Middle notes of red geranium seed, delicate rose and night-blooming jasmine infuse the elixir with a softer, more refined approach. Finally, base notes of Virginia cedar and sensual musk round out the perfume, only to be further enhanced by the element of sugary white honey.

Ptisenbon Tartine et Chocolat For Women was created as an introduction to fragrance for young girls and boys. This gentle mist perfumes young skin with the comforting, sweet scent of nature that’s never overpowering. years of childhood. 3499174169:23123931559.detail_text: CREATION Created in 2005, Un Jardin sur le Nil eau de toilette evokes an olfactory journey to the garden islands in Aswan, Egypt. In this composition, perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena tells of this river synonymous with life and generosity. OLFACTORY NOTES Green and woody, Un Jardin sur le Nil eau de toilette combines tangy green mango with delicate lotus and elegant sycamore. THE OBJECT Designed by Fred Rawyler, the bottle is inspired by the lines of horse-drawn carriage lanterns. Its glass is in a delicate green gradient, evoking the banks of the Nile. The box is illustrated with a lotus flower by artist Veronique de Mareuil. THE PARFUMS-JARDINS COLLECTION The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the theme chosen by Hermès each year to nourish its creativity. They are olfactory strolls to share for every moment, to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape. Olfactory emotion: Fresh, Delicate Main raw materials: Green mango, Lotus, Sycamore wood Made in France Volume: 100 ml
